idea-plugin.name: android-image-squeeze
idea-plugin.description:
Audits and compresses Android image assets. This is not another "Convert to WebP" — the IDE already ships one. The value here is the decision logic it lacks: which route each asset can safely take, and which ones must be left alone.

The route is chosen by the shape of the alpha channel. Assets with hard-edged alpha (only 0 or 255) get lossy RGB plus lossless alpha — a binary channel cannot band, so this needs no knowledge of the host background. Assets with gradient alpha keep almost all of their bytes in the alpha plane. When a single solid host background can be resolved, android-image-squeeze can composite onto it and drop alpha entirely; otherwise it safely falls back to lossless alpha and compresses RGB only.

Three metrics guard the result: banding detection along the gradient (per-pixel error is blind to it), dither-versus-texture classification, and per-pixel delta. Assets under assets/ and nine-patch files are excluded outright — they are data or have stretch markers, not plain images.

Usage: right-click an image in the Project view → Squeeze: Inspect This Image, or open the Image Squeeze tool window to scan the whole project and apply in bulk.

中文说明见项目 README。本插件内置 Google 的 cwebp（libwebp，BSD-3-Clause）， 许可证见 jar 内 licenses/libwebp-COPYING.txt。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1
  • The Project view action is now dumb-aware: it stays usable while the IDE is indexing, which is exactly when a freshly added image used to be unclickable.
  • Refresh the VFS before a full-project scan so newly dropped files are never missed.
  • When no host background can be resolved, a background color can now be entered by hand and actually baked, instead of only re-tinting an empty preview.
0.1.0
  • Audit Android PNG, JPEG and WebP assets from the Project view or tool window.
  • Choose a safe compression route from alpha shape, host background and image texture.
  • Preview the result against detected, preset or manually entered background colors.
  • Apply verified WebP replacements individually or in bulk.

action.description: Analyze this image, preview the compression and optionally replace it
